description: Places an employer name in a country and lists the employers we hold that it may mean, each with a confidence from 0 to 1. For employers we researched it adds what the employer became and its workplace pension plan, each fact with source and read date. Legal entities only.

country.description: Optional. The country worked in: a name, alias or ISO code. Matches are then taken from that country only.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

name.description: The employer name as the person knows it, ideally with legal form and city, for example "Shell Nederland B.V.".

name: resolve_employer
title: Place an employer in a country
